create_code_file_from_two_channels: run create_code_file.py to merge two channel units files into a code file with audio and unit mappings
create_code_file_with_custom_channel_nam: run create_code_file.py with --channels flag to use custom channel names instead of the default unitA and unitB
run_create_code_file_cli: run the create_code_file.py CLI tool with two input units files and an output file path as arguments
review_create_code_file_main: review the main function in create_code_file.py that parses two channel units files and writes merged code entries
summarize_create_code_file: summarize the create_code_file.py script that combines paired channel unit files into a dictionary-based code format
